jobs.title: Director Data Engineering
jobs.description:
At Gore Mutual, we’ve always set ourselves apart as a modern mutual that does good. Now, we’re proudly building on that legacy to transform our company—and our industry—for the better.
Effective January 1, 2026, Gore has joined Beneva—the country’s largest mutual insurance company—as part of its Property & Casualty operations in Ontario and Western Canada. During 2026, Gore will combine its operations with Unica Insurance, Beneva’s Ontario-based subsidiary specializing in niche commercial and personal insurance, creating a stronger, more diversified mutual insurer with greater scale and long-term stability.
Every decision and investment remains anchored in long-term benefits to customers, members, and communities. Come join us.
We are looking for a Director, Data Engineering to lead a critical capability within Gore’s Enterprise Data & Analytics organization. You will lead the teams responsible for turning enterprise data into trusted, reusable data products and building the engineering capabilities that enable Data, Insights and AI across Gore.
You will shape how we build and manage data products, evolve our Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, and ensure our Databricks and Azure ecosystem provides the foundation needed for Analytics, Data Science, GenAI and emerging AI solutions.
This is a visible leadership role for someone who combines strong technical depth with business understanding, people leadership and the ability to turn data and technology investments into meaningful business outcomes.
What will you do?

Build Enterprise Data Products

Lead the development of trusted, reusable data products that combine business meaning, data quality and strong engineering to support operational, analytical, Data Science and AI use cases.
Establish and mature our data product discipline, partnering with business and technology leaders to turn high-value data needs into scalable capabilities.
Improve the accessibility, consistency and value of enterprise data while reducing fragmentation and duplication.

Advance Data Engineering & AI Enablement

Lead and mature Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, creating repeatable paths to move data, machine learning, GenAI and emerging AI solutions into secure, reliable production.
Raise engineering standards across integration, APIs, orchestration, CI/CD, testing, observability, automation, data quality and production operations.
Partner across Data, Analytics and technology teams to provide the engineering capabilities needed to scale Data Science and AI.

Evolve Our Data Technology Foundation

Guide the evolution of Gore’s Databricks and Azure ecosystem to provide a scalable, resilient, secure and cost-effective foundation for Data, Insights and AI.
Partner with IT and Architecture to shape architecture patterns, integration approaches and technology standards.
Evaluate emerging Data and AI technologies based on business value, scalability, security and long-term sustainability.

Build and Lead a Strong Engineering Organization

Lead, coach and develop high-performing teams across Data Products, Data Platforms, Data Engineering and MLOps.
Develop strong managers and technical leaders with clear accountability for products, engineering quality and production outcomes.
Build a culture of ownership, curiosity, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Provide Visible Enterprise Leadership

Represent Data Engineering with senior business and technology leaders, vendors and strategic partners.
Translate complex technology decisions into clear business implications, trade-offs, risks and recommendations.
Provide clear leadership across priorities, investments, delivery and significant operational challenges.

What will you need to succeed?

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
Significant leadership experience across Data Engineering, data products, data platforms, MLOps or related enterprise technology functions.
Proven experience building enterprise data products and translating business needs into reusable, scalable data capabilities.
Proven experience building and operating enterprise-scale data platforms and production data workloads.
Direct production experience with Databricks, including data engineering, lakehouse architecture, governance and optimization.
Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and modern cloud data architectures.
Strong technical knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs, data integration, orchestration and distributed processing.
Experience with technologies such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and MLflow, or comparable capabilities.
Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevOps, DataOps and modern production engineering practices.
Practical MLOps experience enabling Data Science, machine learning and AI workloads in production.
Experience enabling GenAI or emerging AI capabilities in secure enterprise environments.
A strong track record of coaching and developing engineers, managers and technical leaders.
Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior business, technology and external stakeholders.

This posting pertains to an existing vacancy that is actively being filled.

Accessibility for applicants

Gore Mutual Insurance Company is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities during all phases of the recruiting process, including the application process.
If you require accommodation because of a disability, we will work with you to meet your needs. Contact us and a human resources representative will consult with you to determine an appropriate accommodation.
Should you request an accommodation during the interview process, please notify your Talent Acquisition Consultant.

jobs.description:
For a description of key terms used on CRA job notices, go to Definitions for job seekers.

About The Job

The CRA is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free work environment with a diverse workforce that reflects the Canadians we serve. It starts with the hiring process. To find out more about the CRA's actions in support of Employment Equity (EE), diversity and inclusion (DI), and read testimonials from our employees and executives, please visit the following CRA web sites: Employment equity, diversity and inclusion and Our workforce testimonials - Canada.ca.

We encourage you to complete the EEDI Staffing questionnaire as part of your application if you wish to be considered for appointments using the EE and/or DI staffing requirement in this process. Also, ensure that you have provided consent in the EEDI staffing questionnaire for your EEDI information to be used for screening or selection. If you do not complete the questionnaire, you will not be considered for any appointments using the EE and/or DI staffing requirement in this process. If you decide to modify your response or fill out this questionnaire at a later date, please notify the contact listed at the bottom of this notice of job opportunity.

Have you ever wanted to make a difference to the lives of millions of people and influence how government interacts with Canadians? Are you inspired by the possibility of delivering results in a people-centric environment and in an organization that encourages innovation? Do you want to be part of a team that is engaged, collaborative and respectful?

If you answered yes to the above, THIS
is the job for you and CRA is THE
organization for you.

At the CRA, we recognize the importance of creating a healthy and respectful workplace, where our employees are empowered to be themselves and realize their full potential. We value integrity, respect, professionalism and collaboration. At the core of our values is our deep commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion and accessibility. Through experience we know that diversity and inclusion foster innovation and leads to greater engagement, richer discussions, and better results for the people and communities we serve. Learn more about the CRA from an executive's perspective.

We are looking for dynamic, collaborative and strategic leaders with a proven track record to contribute to the People First vision and take the delivery of services to Canadians to the next level while demonstrating character leadership. The CRA is elevating character leadership alongside competencies, as "leading from who you are" is recognized as an important part of the CRA leadership practice.

The Intent Of This Staffing Process Is To Create a Pre-Qualified Pool (PQP) Of EX-02 Qualified Individuals With Specialized Expertise To Fill Current And Future Vacancies Within The Following Headquarters Branches:

Finance and Administration Branch (FAB) (Stream 1)
Information Technology Branch (ITB) (Stream 2)

Who Can Apply
:

Employees of the CRA who occupy a substantive position. If you are an eligible veteran or a Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) member, you may also apply.

For each stream, if the number of applicants is insufficient, the following may be considered: Persons who occupy a substantive position within the Federal Public Service, including Crown corporations and agencies.

Essential Requirements:

Education

For Stream 1 (FAB), have a degree (see note 1) from a recognized post-secondary institution.

For Steam 2 (ITB), have a degree (see note 1) or diploma in computer science, information technology, software/computer engineering, management information systems or a combination of career long IT experience and relevant education.

Experience

For both streams, have recent and significant experience
(see note 2) at the EX-01 group and level (or equivalent or above) in the following:

EXP1
:

Stream 1 (FAB):

Managing human and financial resources (Please be specific: indicate the number of direct reports, subordinates and the dollar figures of the budgets you directly managed for each position in the questionnaire); and

EXP2:

Providing strategic advice and briefings to senior officials (see note 3) on a large and complex (see note 4) program, major project (see note 5), policy or operational issues of a regional or national scale; and

EXP3:

Establishing and maintaining relationships with multiple internal or external stakeholders, which could include other government departments and agencies in order to deliver on government priorities; and

EXP4: (choose one of the following)

(4.1):
Leading, developing and implementing policies, programs, systems, or strategies related to Project and Portfolio Management in the financial field.

OR

(4.2):
Leading, developing and implementing policies, programs, systems, or strategies related to the finance functions such as (but not limited to): Resource Management and Budgeting, Accounting Operations, Financial Policy and Internal Controls, Financial Systems, Financial Reporting, Financial Management Administration, Costing, Internal Audit, Materiel Management or Procurement.

Stream 2 (ITB):

EXP1:

Managing significant human resources (40 FTEs or more) and financial resources ($5M or more); and

EXP2:

Leading complex (see note 4) and innovative services or solutions related to Information Management/ Information Technology (IM/IT) initiatives through subordinate supervisors in a large decentralized organization (see note 6) OR business transformation initiatives enabled by IT in a large decentralized organization; and

EXP3:

Collaborating and maintaining partnerships, and building consensus around issues with both colleagues and a variety of internal and external stakeholders; and

EXP4:

Experience in providing strategic advice and recommendations related to IT programs, major IT projects (see note 5) or IT-related issues to senior officials (see note 3).

This Experience Would Be Considered An Asset:

Steam 1 (FAB):

Providing leadership on corporate services, programs or operational service delivery.
Experience in leading a major complex and horizontal transformation initiative.
Possess or be eligible for a recognized professional accounting designation (CPA, including CA, CMA or CGA).
Experience interacting with central agencies; e.g., the Treasury Board Secretariat or the Department of Finance, on resource management matters.
Experience managing a major project investment or providing oversight of a portfolio of projects.

Stream 2 (ITB):

Broad and deep knowledge of current and emerging technologies (e.g. Artificial Intelligence, Cloud, Quantum), technology directions and strategic application of technologies to support business needs.
Experience in modern IT development practices and methodologies such as DevSecOps, decoupling applications through Application Programming Interfaces (API), Product Management and cloud.
Experience delivering excellent results (projects and operations) in a large complex environment with a mix of emerging, current and legacy technologies.
Experience in the planning, delivery and/or management of IT security programs, services or projects, including in cybersecurity.
Experience in leading more than one IT program (at the executive level) in a large scale organization (see note 6).
Experience providing leadership in information technology within a large organization responsible for the administration of tax and/or benefits programs.

Notes:

Degree: is defined as a baccalaureate or higher level degree.
Recent and significant experience is defined as the depth and breadth of the experience normally associated with having performed a broad range of related activities at the EX-01 group and level or equivalent and above, for a period of two (2) cumulative years in the past five (5) years.
Senior officials are defined as Director General, Assistant Commissioner/Deputy Assistant Commissioner (Assistant Deputy Minister) or equivalent and above.
Complex is defined as having at least three (3) of the following characteristics: multidimensional, sensitive, affecting many partners or stakeholders, precedent setting or having major impact on the organization, or having a potential for significant media coverage.
A major project would normally be an initiative under the oversight of the Agency's Major Project Investment Oversight Process (MPIOP), or other governmental organization equivalent.
A large decentralized organization is defined as a geographically decentralized organization with more than 5,000 employees whose operations are spread over a very large territory.

Conditions Of Employment Required At The Time Of Appointment:

Secret security clearance level
Willingness to travel
Willingness to relocate to the National Capital Region (NCR)
For Steam 1 (FAB), candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application will result in being screened out of the staffing process.
For Stream 2 (ITB), relocate to the NCR may be required for some positions. Candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application may result in not being considered for some positions.

All appointments (except acting appointments) to and within the Executive (EX) Group at the CRA are subject to the Agreement to be laterally moved provision as a mandatory condition of employment. This provision is included in the CRA's Directive on Terms and Conditions of Employment for the EX Group

Languages Requirements:

Bilingual – CBC levels
Candidates must have valid Second Language Evaluation test results at the CBC level at the time of application in order to be considered further in the staffing process. Should your SLE results not be transferable to the CRA, you will be assessed and must meet to be considered further in this staffing process.

To apply

Please submit your curriculum vitae via the CRA's career portal.

A Curriculum Vitae
that Includes:

group and level of your substantive position;
current security clearance level;
education;
for each position occupied/listed:
position titles with the group and level;
name of organization;
duration (years and months); and
the number of direct and indirect reports, and the dollar figures of the budgets you directly managed and were accountable for.

In addition, please complete the following questionnaires, which are part of the application process:

Generic Questionnaire:
Mobility:
For Steam 1 (FAB), candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application will result in being screened out of the staffing process.
For Stream 2 (ITB), relocate to the NCR may be required for some positions. Candidates not currently located in NCR or within commuting distance must indicate in their application their willingness to relocate. Failure to do so at the time of application may result in not being considered for some positions.

Substantive Group and Level: You will be asked to indicate your substantive group and level.
Second Language Evaluation (SLE): You will be asked to indicate your SLE Results with the expiration dates.
Security Clearance: You will be asked to indicate your current security clearance.
Job Performance and Talent Management: You will be asked to indicate your performance rating and talent map placement for the last two years, if applicable.
Essential Requirements:
Education: For Stream 1 (FAB), you will be asked to identify if you have a degree from a recognized post-secondary institution. For Stream 2 (ITB), you will be asked to identify your educational credentials and, where applicable, provide a copy of your degree or diploma in computer science, information technology

jobs.title: Director, Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 276133

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, Strategic Initiatives leads enterprise productivity, cost optimization, program execution, financial governance and benefits realization. The Director, Economics focuses on technology investment economics, analytical frameworks, portfolio evaluation and investment decision support. Senior Managers execute assigned analysis and work products rather than own enterprise program outcomes.

Provide strategic leadership in technology financial governance, productivity improvement, and cost optimization across ScotiaTech. Lead Project Falcon and coordinate the delivery of assigned financial and productivity commitments, working with Technology, Finance, Procurement, HR and executive leadership to establish governance, drive accountability and support informed decisions

Scope And Accountability

Accountable for the leadership, coordination, governance, and delivery of assigned strategic initiatives, including Project Falcon and its associated financial and productivity commitments. Sets priorities, provides direction, oversees execution, and drives stakeholder alignment. Detailed modeling, financial analysis, reporting and reviews may be performed by Senior Managers and other team members under Director oversight

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Falcon program leadership

Lead Project Falcon execution and coordinate delivery of agreed savings and productivity objectives
Establish program governance, delivery plans, performance measures, and reporting requirements
Drive accountability across CIO organizations; manage dependencies, risks, and escalations
Develop and maintain a pipeline of sustainable cost optimization opportunities

Technology financial governance

Provide leadership and oversight of technology financial planning, forecasting, and spending management
Partner with Finance to assess performance, identify budget risks and validate financial impacts
Drive consistent financial transparency, controls, reporting, and management accountability
Align financial management activities with Global Technology priorities

Strategic productivity and transformation

Lead evaluation and prioritization of productivity opportunities across workforce, vendor management, platforms, infrastructure, and operations
Coordinate stakeholders to assess alternatives, financial trade-offs, and execution readiness
Support implementation of prioritized transformation and cost optimization initiatives
Contribute to longer-term technology productivity plans and transformation roadmaps

Benefits Tracking And Validation

Establish consistent methods to measure, track, and report financial savings and productivity benefits
Work with Finance and initiative owners to validate assumptions, evidence, and actual results
Monitor progress against commitments, address emerging gaps and avoid double-counting benefits
Maintain clear governance, documentation, and accountability for reported outcomes

Executive reporting and stakeholder management

Provide executive-ready updates on Falcon performance, strategic initiatives, financial risks, and delivery issues
Prepare governance materials, presentations, decision options, and recommendations
Partner with CIOs, Finance, Procurement, HR and senior stakeholders to align priorities and resolve issues

Team leadership and management

Lead assigned team members, set priorities, and establish clear expectations and deliverables
Provide coaching, performance feedback, and development support
Oversee allocation of analytical, financial management and program-support work
Promote collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and an inclusive working environment

Governance, controls, and risk management

Establish appropriate controls and decision processes for assigned strategic initiatives
Identify and manage program, financial and operational risks and escalate significant issues
Ensure activities follow applicable Bank policies, risk practices, and financial governance standards

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required, preferably in the disciplines of Business Management
Strategic, functional, and operational planning skills
Demonstrated experience with large scale initiatives
Effective communication skills
Highly curious and strong problem-solving skills
Demonstrated proficiency in leading change through others to achieve operational excellence.
Solid experience and proven record in working closely with senior management across centres of excellence, along with conceptual and critical thinking
Excellent written and verbal skills - able to convey messages that can be understood across all levels of the organization from the ground level through the executive and board level
Experience working very well in cross-functional teams and is a champion of collaboration and change
Ability to seamlessly engage colleagues, business partners, external stakeholders, and employees to define a shared / common goal
Ability to manage significant ambiguity and constantly changing circumstances in a fast-paced environment
Strong interpersonal skills, including superior listening and probing skills, and the ability to build rapport across the company while quickly and confidently gaining respect of others.
Strong coaching and feedback skills that promote leadership and enhance team performance
Proven ability to exercise good judgment, initiative, and maintain confidentiality

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, Humans of Digital and much more

Participate in strategic initiatives and projects including product development and launch, implementation of tools and technology to enhance ATBIM’s investment management capabilities

Collaborate internally with ATBIM leadership team and ATB Financial teams (Finance, Internal Assurance, Third Party Risk Management, Legal, etc).

CPA or equivalent professional designation required
10-15+ years of progressive experience in the investment industry
Tax training and experience considered a strong asset
Subject matter expertise in industry rules and regulations, along with a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory landscape and proposed changes.
Progressive leadership experience with the ability to motivate, coach and develop a high performing team

Highly developed problem solving skills and professional judgment in handling complex or unexpected situations objectively by assessing situations, identifying and weighing alternative options, and making data-driven recommendations to solve problems.

Ability to work under pressure to manage competing and often time-sensitive priorities and deadlines with a high degree of ownership and accountability

Are you a visionary leader ready to shape the future of transportation infrastructure across our Canada geography? Minimum 12 years in leadership roles in engineering consulting operations focused on infrastructure and/or transportation markets
Engineering or business degree
Proven success delivering large, complex projects and programs
Strong financial acumen, including P&L accountability

The Director, Program Management reports into the VP, Delivery & Portfolio Management supporting a large-scale program within the [Canadian Banking] portfolio. We are looking for someone who thinks like a product and service designer: You are curious about users, able to simplify complex systems, and are comfortable working across technology, process and organizational boundaries. .

Design experiences around what employees and managers are trying to accomplish rather than around PE's internal organizational structure.
Launch the manager and employee experience product roadmaps.

Lead the user experience design for the PE AI Assistant (AIA), from initial launch through continued expansion.
Define and drive implementation of digital journeys that optimize the use and adoption of the AI-enabled digital experiences.

Use data from the AIA, People Services, technology platforms, and direct user feedback to identify improvement opportunities and create a continuous feedback loop into PE's product and process roadmap.

Experience integrating AI capabilities to improve the efficacy and quality of employee or customer experiences

Asana is looking for a Head of Content Design to lead and grow our content design practice across the company. You'll manage a team of content designers working across our portfolio of products: Agentic Work Management, Service Management, Client Management, and Command. You'll set the standard for how Asana speaks to customers on every surface, from a settings page to a conversation with an AI Teammate. In this player-coach role, you'll lead the practice, develop senior practitioners, and take on some of the highest-stakes writing projects yourself while collaborating with the Asana Design leadership team to shape both what we make and how we make it.

We design the future of teamwork. Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world's teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission.

Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community. We're a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds (product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting). We are a team that loves combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centred design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design. We use design to solve challenges and create experiences that customers love. We also take the time to get weird and have fun along the way.

We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Lead, coach, and grow a team of content designers by setting clear expectations, developing their craft and careers, and building a team with a clear mission and measurable outcomes.
Own the end-to-end quality of content across Asana's portfolio of products, including Agentic Work Management, Service Management, Client Management, and Command.
Define and evolve Asana’s product voice, terminology, and content standards, building scalable systems—such as guidelines, patterns, design-system content, and tooling—that empower every product team.
Establish Asana’s AI voice by defining the voice and tone for AI Teammates and agents, developing conversation design patterns, and distilling characteristics that make humans and agents feel like one team.
Partner with Design, Product Management, Engineering, Research, and Product Marketing leaders to integrate content strategy into roadmap decisions and make content design a visible, measurable part of how Asana ships.
Collaborate with Marketing and Brand Creative to ensure a cohesive voice and tone across the entire customer journey.
Lead high-impact content design initiatives, including flagship launches, AI and conversational experiences, cross-product naming, and information architecture.
Partner with Research and Data Science to validate content decisions through experiments and user studies, advocating for content improvements backed by evidence.
Shape how the broader Asana Design organization operates as a member of its leadership team, including evolving design and content workflows alongside AI-assisted product development.

Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
10+ years of experience designing content for digital products, including 4+ years managing content designers or UX writers and developing senior and lead-level practitioners.
Proven track record of running a day-to-day content design practice—setting priorities across multiple teams, driving consistency, shipping products, and advocating for content design best practices cross-functionally.
Demonstrated ability to build influence with Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders so content design is embedded early in decision-making rather than treated as a final review step.
Hands-on expertise in UX writing and content strategy for web and mobile products, covering microcopy, nomenclature, information architecture, accessibility, user education, and launch content.
Experience designing content for conversational or AI-powered experiences, paired with a clear point of view on how products should communicate when systems generate language.
Experience creating, governing, and scaling voice and tone guidelines and content systems—including AI content tooling—that cross-functional teams actively adopt.

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Reporting to the Senior Director, Business Development, you will own the proactive sourcing and origination of independent pharmacy acquisition opportunities within an assigned Canadian territory. You will build trusted, long-term relationships with pharmacy owners and their advisors, understand owners’ business and succession objectives, and ensure Shoppers Drug Mart is a credible, reliable and ethical acquisition partner. You will qualify and advance opportunities in collaboration with Finance, Operations, Real Estate, Legal and other internal partners. This is an origination-led, mixed office/field based role with relationship ownership throughout the transaction process.

Originate opportunities and develop owner relationships

Develop and execute a territory-level acquisition sourcing plan, including mapping independent pharmacy targets, assessing strategic fit, and prioritizing high-potential prospects.
Proactively create proprietary and off-market opportunities through field visits, direct outreach, referrals, industry events and thoughtful use of sourcing technology.
Build consultative, multi-year relationships with pharmacy owners; understand succession timelines, motivations, business priorities and circumstances that could lead to a sale.
Cultivate a network of trusted referral sources and intermediaries, including relevant advisors, brokers, accountants, lenders and pharmacy industry contacts.

Qualify and advance acquisitions

Assess prospective acquisitions against strategic, commercial and operational criteria, including prescription trends, store economics, location, lease considerations, competitive dynamics and execution risks.

UN CLUB DE SPORT PROFESSIONNEL, MAIS PLUS ENCORE!

Founded in 1992, CF Montréal is a Canadian soccer club.

With more than 130 full-time employees and over 300 staff members during the match season, CF Montréal is a pioneer in the Canadian soccer landscape. Are you an ambitious individual looking to help shape the new face of professional soccer in Montréal and Québec? Join our team today!

A PROFESSIONAL SPORTS CLUB, AND SO MUCH MORE!

Description du poste

La personne responsable de l’analytique et de l’intelligence sportive a comme principale mission de soutenir la gestion et l'optimisation de l'effectif du club en utilisant des outils analytiques. La personne favorisera la collaboration entre les départements et fournira des informations analytiques supportant le processus décisionnel dans le département sportif. Ce poste implique la collecte et l'analyse de données, la collaboration dans les processus de recrutement et la coordination des efforts entre les parties prenantes pour optimiser les performances sportives du club.

The Head of Sporting Analytics and insights is responsible for supporting the management and optimization of the club’s roster using analytical tools. The person will promote collaboration between departments and provide analytical insights to support the decision making process in the sporting department. This position involves data collection and analysis, collaboration in scouting processes, and coordination of efforts among stakeholders to optimize club performance.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

Soutenir l'analyse et la gestion de l'effectif professionnel du Club en utilisant des outils et des méthodologies analytiques.
Établir une collaboration efficace entre les départements pour créer des synergies dans les activités de conformité de l'effectif, de recrutement et d'analytique.
Consolider les rapports de recrutement et d'analytique, organiser et soutenir les efforts sur le plafond salarial de l'équipe et les contrats des joueurs, et assister à la stratégie de l'effectif en fournissant des informations et des conseils à la direction et aux autres parties prenantes.
Rechercher et analyser des données statistiques et présenter les résultats sous forme de rapports et de résumés exécutifs.
Mettre en œuvre des processus pour garantir que des informations complètes, fiables et robustes sont utilisées pour la prise de décision.
Interpréter, déchiffrer et synthétiser plusieurs sources de données en utilisant SQL.
Diriger la mise en œuvre des meilleures pratiques analytiques dans les départements de recrutement, médical et de performance.
Créer des rapports d'analyse, des listes restreintes et des présentations en utilisant des données et des rapports internes tout en optimisant les processus et la communication.
Soutenir les processus de recrutement en collectant et en organisant des informations sur les joueurs potentiels.
Fournir une assistance pour la préparation des réunions reliée à la stratégie de l'effectif et de tous les repêchages de la MLS.
Collaborer aux interactions et à la synergie entre les départements liés à l'acquisition de joueurs (conformité de l'effectif, recrutement, analytique et opérations).
Interpréter les règles et les directives reliées à l'effectif et au budget de la MLS.
Formuler des recommandations sur les améliorations possibles ;
Effectuer d’autres tâches et responsabilités connexes.

Main responsabilities

Support the analysis and management of the Club’s professional roster by leveraging analytical tools and methodologies.
Establish efficient collaboration across departments to create synergies within Roster Compliance, Scouting, and Analytics activities.
Consolidate scouting and analytics reports, organize and support efforts on the team’s salary cap and players’ contracts, assist on the roster strategy by providing insight and guidance to leadership and other stakeholders.
Research and analyze statistical data and present findings through reports and executive summaries.
Implement processes to ensure that comprehensive, robust, and reliable information is used for decision making.
Query, decipher, and summarize multiple data sources using SQL.
Lead the implementation of best analytics practices across scouting, medical and performance departments.
Create analysis reports, shortlists, and presentations using data and internal reports while optimizing processes and communication.
Support scouting processes in the collection and organization of information on potential players.
Provide assistance with the preparation of roster strategy meetings and all MLS drafts.
Support the interaction and synergy between departments linked to player acquisition (Roster Compliance, Scouting, Analytics and Operations)
Interpret rules and guidelines of the MLS roster and budget.
Make recommendations for possible improvements.
Perform other related tasks and responsibilities.

Qualifications

Expérience significative en analyse de données et capacité à interpréter et exploiter les données pour fournir des tendances et des perspectives.
Passion pour l'amélioration des processus, le sport, l'analyse de données et le soccer.
Un minimum de cinq (5) ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'analyse et d'interprétation de données, de préférence dans l'industrie du sport et du soccer.
Baccalauréat dans le domaine de l'économie, des statistiques, des mathématiques, de la science des données ou de l'ingénierie est souhaitable.
Des études supérieures tel qu’une maitrise ou un doctorat dans un domaine connexe, sont un atout.
Expérience de gestion des fonctions analytiques générant des outils de visualisation pour les utilisateurs.
Expérience dans le développement et l'optimisation de budgets.
Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement dans un environnement collaboratif.
Capacité à effectuer plusieurs tâches dans un environnement à rythme rapide et de façon autonome ;
Bonne compréhension de l’écosystème MLS et la connaissance des règles de l'effectif de la MLS est un atout important.
Connaissance des bases de données, de la conception et de l'utilisation des IPA (API) pour gérer des ensembles de données.
Expérience avec des logiciels de performance (Wyscout, SkillCorner, Sportscode, Statsbomb, etc.).
Expérience fonctionnelle dans un langage de script, tel que Python, R ou Javascript, est un atout.
Maîtrise des logiciels Microsoft Office et de la gestion de bases de données.
Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit ; la personne aura à établir des relations d’affaires à l’intérieur et à l’extérieur du Québec et transiger avec la Major League Soccer basée aux États-Unis.
Démontrer de la flexibilité dans les heures et jours de travail (soirs, fins de semaines et jours fériés) ainsi que dans le voyagement pour affaire ;

Extensive experience in data analysis and the ability to interpret and exploit data to provide trends and insights.

At Xero, we are here to make running a business beautiful by helping small businesses thrive and building a stronger economy. As Director of Partner Retention for Xero Canada, you will guide our Enterprise and Field Partner channel and the people within it, shaping our post-sales growth, utility, expansion, and account management strategy across Canadian regions.

In this role, you will coach a team of Partner Success Managers (PSMs) and Enterprise PSMs to deliver meaningful outcomes for our accounting and bookkeeping partners while hitting revenue, subscription, and activation targets. By nurturing strong relationships with key enterprise and field stakeholders, refining our sales motions, and mitigating churn, you will directly expand recurring revenue and strengthen Xero's market presence across Canada.

The Team / How They Connect

You will manage a dedicated team of Partner Success Managers and Enterprise PSMs who look after our existing field and enterprise accounting and bookkeeping partners across Canada. Together, your team supports partner onboarding, product adoption, account expansion, and long-term retention through regular business reviews and tailored territory planning. You will also collaborate closely with the Director of Partner Services, the Post PDR team, and cross-functional colleagues across sales enablement, product, marketing, legal, and operations to create a seamless partner experience.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on

Maintaining strong CRM discipline and using operational tools for accurate month-over-month forecasting, pipeline coverage, and sales execution.
Delivering quarterly and bi-annual business reviews with key enterprise and field partners across Canada to uncover growth opportunities and retention levers.
Spending time in the field coaching team members throughout the retention and growth cycle to lift activation velocity, upsell and cross-sell revenue, and conversion rates.
Partnering with the Director of Partner Services and the Post PDR team to refine post-sales motions, expand key enterprise accounts, and build repeatable processes that protect market share.

Where And How You Can Work

This role is based in Canada and supports partners and team members across Canadian regions. We offer a flexible hybrid working approach that blends remote work with in-person connection days at our Canadian offices, alongside regular time in the field coaching your team and attending partner channel events.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

You bring proven experience in sales or relationship management with field and enterprise clients, alongside a strong track record of achieving revenue, retention, and growth targets.
Coaching and mentoring people comes naturally to you, with a people-focused mindset that builds accountability, product knowledge, and a supportive team culture.
Your background includes shaping repeatable sales processes, managing pipeline forecasting with strong CRM habits, and guiding long enterprise sales cycles.
Collaborating across departments is one of your strengths, allowing you to work smoothly with product, marketing, legal, customer success, and sales operations teams.
Clear, empathetic communication and confident public speaking skills help you build trust with senior partner stakeholders and represent Xero at industry events.

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - ensuring your value is recognized through a holistic lens that includes base salary, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Reporting to the Senior Director, Business Development, you will own the proactive sourcing and origination of independent pharmacy acquisition opportunities within an assigned Canadian territory. You will build trusted, long-term relationships with pharmacy owners and their advisors, understand owners’ business and succession objectives, and ensure Shoppers Drug Mart is a credible, reliable and ethical acquisition partner. You will qualify and advance opportunities in collaboration with Finance, Operations, Real Estate, Legal and other internal partners. This is an origination-led, mixed office/field based role with relationship ownership throughout the transaction process.

Originate opportunities and develop owner relationships

Develop and execute a territory-level acquisition sourcing plan, including mapping independent pharmacy targets, assessing strategic fit, and prioritizing high-potential prospects.
Proactively create proprietary and off-market opportunities through field visits, direct outreach, referrals, industry events and thoughtful use of sourcing technology.
Build consultative, multi-year relationships with pharmacy owners; understand succession timelines, motivations, business priorities and circumstances that could lead to a sale.
Cultivate a network of trusted referral sources and intermediaries, including relevant advisors, brokers, accountants, lenders and pharmacy industry contacts.

Qualify and advance acquisitions

Assess prospective acquisitions against strategic, commercial and operational criteria, including prescription trends, store economics, location, lease considerations, competitive dynamics and execution risks.
Gather and validate information needed for preliminary screening and valuation; partner with Finance and other teams to develop recommendations and support investment decisions.
Lead owner-facing discussions and negotiate approved commercial terms and offers, including letters of intent where appropriate, within established approval parameters.
Remain the principal relationship contact for owners as opportunities progress through diligence, internal approvals, negotiation and closing; coordinate closely with Legal, Operations, Real Estate and Finance.
Coordinate a smooth handoff to the teams responsible for transition and integration, maintaining effective seller communication as appropriate.

Manage the pipeline and territory

Maintain a current, well-qualified acquisition pipeline in the CRM, with accurate contact histories, next steps, deal stages, risks, anticipated timing and forecasts.
Track sourcing effectiveness using measures such as target coverage, meaningful owner engagement, qualified opportunities, offers, conversion and completed acquisitions; share market intelligence with leadership.
Monitor local industry developments and competitor activity, refine territory priorities, and use data, automation and other tools responsibly to improve sourcing effectiveness.

new_jobs.description:
Description de l'entreprise

Fondé en 1992, le CF Montréal est une équipe canadienne de soccer. Évoluant à travers les années, le club est une franchise de la Ligue Majeure de Soccer (MLS) depuis 2012 soit une ligue professionnelle comprenant l’élite du Canada et des États-Unis. Comptant plus de 130 employés permanents et plus de 300 lors de la saison des matchs, le CF Montréal est un précurseur dans le milieu du soccer au Canada. Le CF Montréal comprend une équipe dynamique et passionnée évoluant dans un environnement de travail stimulant et toujours en évolution! Tu es une personne ambitieuse, voulant participer à bâtir le nouveau visage du soccer professionnel à Montréal, au Québec? Joins-toi à notre équipe dès maintenant!

UN CLUB DE SPORT PROFESSIONNEL, MAIS PLUS ENCORE!

Founded in 1992, CF Montréal is a Canadian soccer club.
Having evolved over the years, the club has been a Major League Soccer (MLS) franchise since 2012, competing in the premier professional soccer league featuring top teams from Canada and the United States. With more than 130 full-time employees and over 300 staff members during the match season, CF Montréal is a pioneer in the Canadian soccer landscape. The club is made up of a dynamic and passionate team that thrives in a stimulating and ever-evolving work environment.

Are you an ambitious individual looking to help shape the new face of professional soccer in Montréal and Québec? Join our team today!

A PROFESSIONAL SPORTS CLUB, AND SO MUCH MORE!

Description du poste

La personne responsable de l’analytique et de l’intelligence sportive a comme principale mission de soutenir la gestion et l'optimisation de l'effectif du club en utilisant des outils analytiques. La personne favorisera la collaboration entre les départements et fournira des informations analytiques supportant le processus décisionnel dans le département sportif. Ce poste implique la collecte et l'analyse de données, la collaboration dans les processus de recrutement et la coordination des efforts entre les parties prenantes pour optimiser les performances sportives du club.

The Head of Sporting Analytics and insights is responsible for supporting the management and optimization of the club’s roster using analytical tools. The person will promote collaboration between departments and provide analytical insights to support the decision making process in the sporting department. This position involves data collection and analysis, collaboration in scouting processes, and coordination of efforts among stakeholders to optimize club performance.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS

Soutenir l'analyse et la gestion de l'effectif professionnel du Club en utilisant des outils et des méthodologies analytiques.
Établir une collaboration efficace entre les départements pour créer des synergies dans les activités de conformité de l'effectif, de recrutement et d'analytique.
Consolider les rapports de recrutement et d'analytique, organiser et soutenir les efforts sur le plafond salarial de l'équipe et les contrats des joueurs, et assister à la stratégie de l'effectif en fournissant des informations et des conseils à la direction et aux autres parties prenantes.
Rechercher et analyser des données statistiques et présenter les résultats sous forme de rapports et de résumés exécutifs.
Mettre en œuvre des processus pour garantir que des informations complètes, fiables et robustes sont utilisées pour la prise de décision.
Interpréter, déchiffrer et synthétiser plusieurs sources de données en utilisant SQL.
Diriger la mise en œuvre des meilleures pratiques analytiques dans les départements de recrutement, médical et de performance.
Créer des rapports d'analyse, des listes restreintes et des présentations en utilisant des données et des rapports internes tout en optimisant les processus et la communication.
Soutenir les processus de recrutement en collectant et en organisant des informations sur les joueurs potentiels.
Fournir une assistance pour la préparation des réunions reliée à la stratégie de l'effectif et de tous les repêchages de la MLS.
Collaborer aux interactions et à la synergie entre les départements liés à l'acquisition de joueurs (conformité de l'effectif, recrutement, analytique et opérations).
Interpréter les règles et les directives reliées à l'effectif et au budget de la MLS.
Formuler des recommandations sur les améliorations possibles ;
Effectuer d’autres tâches et responsabilités connexes.

Main responsabilities

Support the analysis and management of the Club’s professional roster by leveraging analytical tools and methodologies.
Establish efficient collaboration across departments to create synergies within Roster Compliance, Scouting, and Analytics activities.
Consolidate scouting and analytics reports, organize and support efforts on the team’s salary cap and players’ contracts, assist on the roster strategy by providing insight and guidance to leadership and other stakeholders.
Research and analyze statistical data and present findings through reports and executive summaries.
Implement processes to ensure that comprehensive, robust, and reliable information is used for decision making.
Query, decipher, and summarize multiple data sources using SQL.
Lead the implementation of best analytics practices across scouting, medical and performance departments.
Create analysis reports, shortlists, and presentations using data and internal reports while optimizing processes and communication.
Support scouting processes in the collection and organization of information on potential players.
Provide assistance with the preparation of roster strategy meetings and all MLS drafts.
Support the interaction and synergy between departments linked to player acquisition (Roster Compliance, Scouting, Analytics and Operations)
Interpret rules and guidelines of the MLS roster and budget.
Make recommendations for possible improvements.
Perform other related tasks and responsibilities.

Qualifications

Expérience significative en analyse de données et capacité à interpréter et exploiter les données pour fournir des tendances et des perspectives.
Passion pour l'amélioration des processus, le sport, l'analyse de données et le soccer.
Un minimum de cinq (5) ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'analyse et d'interprétation de données, de préférence dans l'industrie du sport et du soccer.
Baccalauréat dans le domaine de l'économie, des statistiques, des mathématiques, de la science des données ou de l'ingénierie est souhaitable.
Des études supérieures tel qu’une maitrise ou un doctorat dans un domaine connexe, sont un atout.
Expérience de gestion des fonctions analytiques générant des outils de visualisation pour les utilisateurs.
Expérience dans le développement et l'optimisation de budgets.
Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement dans un environnement collaboratif.
Capacité à effectuer plusieurs tâches dans un environnement à rythme rapide et de façon autonome ;
Bonne compréhension de l’écosystème MLS et la connaissance des règles de l'effectif de la MLS est un atout important.
Connaissance des bases de données, de la conception et de l'utilisation des IPA (API) pour gérer des ensembles de données.
Expérience avec des logiciels de performance (Wyscout, SkillCorner, Sportscode, Statsbomb, etc.).
Expérience fonctionnelle dans un langage de script, tel que Python, R ou Javascript, est un atout.
Maîtrise des logiciels Microsoft Office et de la gestion de bases de données.
Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit ; la personne aura à établir des relations d’affaires à l’intérieur et à l’extérieur du Québec et transiger avec la Major League Soccer basée aux États-Unis.
Démontrer de la flexibilité dans les heures et jours de travail (soirs, fins de semaines et jours fériés) ainsi que dans le voyagement pour affaire ;

Qualifications

Required qualifications

Extensive experience in data analysis and the ability to interpret and exploit data to provide trends and insights.
Passion for process improvement, sports, data analysis, and soccer.
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in a role of data analysis and interpretation, preferably in the sports and soccer industry.
Bachelor’s degree in the field of economics, statistics, math, data science or engineering desirable.
Additional educational qualifications including a Master’s or PhD in related field is an asset
Experience in leading data functions that result in visualization productions with insights for end-users.
Experience in budget development and optimization.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively within a collaborative environment.
Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment and autonomously.
Good understanding of the MLS ecosystem and knowledge of MLS roster rules is an important asset.
Knowledge of databases, database design and usage of API’s to manage data sets.
Experience with performance software (Wyscout, SkillCorner, Sportscode, Statsbomb, etc.) is an asset.
Functional experience in scripting language, such as Python, R, or Javascript is an asset
Proficiency in Microsoft Office software and database management.
Knowledge of French, both spoken and written; the person will have to establish business relationships inside Quebec.
Requires flexibility towards working hours and days (evenings, weekends, and holidays) as well as with business travel.
